# Sidecar Apps

> Sidecar Apps builds focused applications that use AI to make everyday tasks easier to understand and act on.

Canonical website: https://sidecar360.com/

## Current product

- [CasaSense](https://casasense.sidecar360.com/): A home intelligence application that helps people identify and organize appliances, understand age and maintenance needs, review recalls, plan repairs or replacements, and share a home inventory with family members.

CasaSense is currently in testing and is not yet listed in the public app stores.

## How Sidecar Apps uses AI

- Photos and equipment labels can be analyzed to reduce manual data entry.
- Extracted details include their source and confidence so people can review uncertain information.
- Home and appliance context is organized into practical maintenance, repair, recall, warranty, and replacement actions.
- Users choose what to save, share, or send to a contractor.
- Sidecar Apps does not represent an AI estimate as an inspection, warranty decision, recall determination, or contractor quote.
